payload.text: (2026-09-18 09:17Z) ON THE BOUNCE (vc, under hv's pen): ST0078's four work packages and eleven criteria are minted from the accepted design at 78734a316 and assigned, cc WP-01 (P1, M), ic WP-02 (P2, M) and WP-04 (P4, S, closes last), dc WP-03 (P3, S, lands first); landing order P3, P2, P1, P4, each on vc's word. Issue 0455 moves from ic to dc because it is the code site P3 rewrites, and closes inside WP-03's bank. cc's 0450 bank (patch-id 4094e77bc) is judged green on its whole-suite run and vc's re-check on HEAD and has the word to land; 0450 stays open until hv restarts intentd and a live doctor re-read is clean. Two assumptions stated to hv: the ingest door is built as `intent sync --ingest` (hv has no strong preference and may rename it before WP-03 lands), and no backfill of the events the store already holds goes into WP-01's bank until hv rules (vc recommends an idempotent backfill in `intent upgrade` as the package's separable last commit, so this project's own history travels).
